text: Close your eyes and bring to mind the Devi in today's alankaram.
Meditate quietly for a few moments, then join your hands and bow.
Meditate on the Devi as Bala Tripurasundari.
The verse means: May Bala Tripurasundari, who holds the noose, goad, book and rosary in her hands and shines with a red radiance, protect us.
